name: sim_ac2_mercedes_standings_priority
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows!
User: How did Mercedes do recently and where do we stand in the championship?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_driver_standings with args {'season': 2026.0, 'category': 'all'}
Agent: According to the latest available 2026 data, Mercedes AMG Petronas is leading the Constructors Championship in first place with 538 points. In the Drivers Championship, Kimi Antonelli in car 12 is in first place with 302 points and George Russell in car 63 is in second place with 236 points. It has been a fantastic season for the Silver Arrows with eleven wins and twenty podiums so far.
User: That is great news, thanks for the update!
Agent: You are very welcome. It is a brilliant time to be a Silver Arrows fan with both Kimi Antonelli and George Russell performing so well at the top of the standings. According to the latest available 2026 data, the team is in a strong position, and we are all excited to see how the rest of the season unfolds. Would you like to know when the next race is or check out the latest team gear?

step_details.goal: Ask how Mercedes performed recently and how the Formula 1 championship standings look
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up the standings and highlights Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell first before mentioning broader F1 standings. Receiving the Mercedes-first standings summary counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent successfully met the success criteria; user is closing the interaction.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up driver and constructor standings without encountering any tool error
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the 'get_driver_standings' tool, which returned a success status and provided both driver and constructor standings.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent answered with the championship standings immediately on the first turn without claiming there was a hiccup or asking the user to clarify whether they want driver or constructor standings
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided a direct answer including both driver and constructor standings in its first response without any requests for clarification or error reporting.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent prioritized Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell before mentioning other teams
expectation_details.justification: The agent presented Mercedes' leadership in the Constructors Championship and the specific standings of Kimi Antonelli and George Russell first, without mentioning any other teams in its initial response.
